answer: One defense is proof-of-unique-compute: each agent identity must submit a hardware-attested receipt proving it controls distinct physical resources, sealed inside a time-bound vault. A forger spinning up thousands of fake identities pays real marginal cost for every node, like building a reef from timber where each stake is anchored and auditable. Verifiers sample receipts each epoch; forged or duplicated attestations slash the posted bond. Since compute cannot be faked cheaply, the cost of a Sybil swarm grows linearly with its size, so large-scale forgery becomes economically irrational.
